path.title: Sounds first
goals: Recognise the extra letters ch, dd, ff, ng, ll, ph, rh, th
Say ll and ch without panic

path.title: Greetings and courtesy
goals: Switch informal ti vs formal/plural chi
practice: Roleplay meeting a shop assistant vs a friend

path.title: I am / I am doing
goals: Produce dw i / dw i'n + verb-noun
practice: 10 sentences: Dw i'n ... / Dw i ddim yn ...

path.title: Soft mutation survival kit
goals: Recognise i Gymru, y gath, ei dad
practice: Mutate: Cymru, tad, cath, pen, llyfr after i / y (fem) / ei (his)

path.title: Numbers, days, time words
practice: Say today's day and the date

path.title: Nasal and aspirate (recognition)
goals: Spot fy nhad and a thad
practice: Classify 12 mutated forms as SM / NM / AM / none
